requirements.text: The system shall ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations and standards to guarantee legal accountability.
The system shall maintain a unified audit trail of all transactions for a minimum of 5 years to enhance accountability.
The system shall implement role-based access control to restrict user permissions while ensuring comprehensive oversight.
The system shall include mechanisms to detect and alert users about potential discrepancies or fraud efficiently.
The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are processed within 2 seconds to optimize responsiveness.
The system shall support concurrent processing of at least 100 users to ensure adequate throughput.
The system shall utilize efficient data structures to minimize memory usage by 30% compared to traditional methods.
The system shall generate financial reports in under 5 seconds for datasets up to 10,000 transactions.
The system shall ensure all financial transactions are encrypted during transmission and storage.
The system shall validate data input to prevent unauthorized or malicious data entry.
The system shall implement efficient algorithms to minimize energy consumption during processing.
The system shall provide multi-currency support with transparent exchange rates to ensure fairness.
